items.title: Hannover Re, Munich Re fall 4% as J.P. Morgan sees weaker reinsurance pricing
items.summary: Investing.com -- Shares in Hannover Re and Munich Re fell 4.4% and 4.2%, respectively, on Friday after J.P. Morgan downgraded both reinsurers, warning that reinsurance prices could fall further in 2027 following a benign 2026 hurricane season.
